name: E4sy SQLi [WAF-PL2]
description: TSCCTF 2025 / E4sy SQLi: User-controlled data reaches a database query through string interpolation, dynamic query construction, or a custom sanitizer instead of strict parameter binding. Injection type is SQL Injection. Attack surface: unauthenticated web parameters, login/search forms, JSON bodies, or API query fields that feed database/query logic. Recommended strategy: Exploit weak query handling around discount/coupon lookup; README asks not to use sqlmap, so use manual payloads.
scoring_rationale: Estimated from local source/README, not official CTF points or solves. Difficulty Easy (1) because single primitive, straightforward payload, and minimal setup. Factors: no auth. Impact 8.8 because successful exploitation can bypass authentication or extract hidden database rows/flag material.
